[[Kurzick Priest]]s are found at certain [[Resurrection Shrine]]s. They are not hostile, but may have either a friendly or unfriendly attitude to your party depending on party members' unspent [[faction]]:
*If any party member has more unspent [[Kurzick faction]] points than Luxon, the priest will offer [[Blessing of the Kurzicks]] for 100 gold.
*If every party member has more unspent [[Luxon faction]] points than Kurzick, the priest will give you the option to either fight him or bribe him. Bribing him costs 50 gold, activates the shrine, makes the four Kurzick [[Non-player character|NPCs]] at the shrine friendly, and gives you +10 Kurzick faction points. The priest will then offer you the Blessing of the Kurzicks as above. If you choose to fight him, he and the other Kurzick NPCs at the shrine will turn hostile and attack you.

==Notes==
*The bribe only needs to be paid once per [[party]] per shrine.
*The priests tend to follow allies if any of them need to be healed, especially [[minion]]s since they have constant health degeneration. You can have all the priests of one area following you if you have a [[minion master]] in your [[party]].
*The priest's attitude towards the party is fixed the first time a player enters [[compass range]] and can only be changed by bribing the priest.
**A party member with more unspent Kurzick faction than Luxon faction does not have to be in range to affect the priest's attitude, but they must still be in the map.
**If a party member's allegiance changes due to gaining faction while in the map, only shrine NPCs who have not yet been within compass range of a player will respect the change.
**If the first player to load the map has more unspent Luxon faction than Kurzick faction, a Kurzick Priest within compass range of the party's entry point will be unfriendly and require bribing even if other party members have more Luxon faction than Kurzick faction.
**The resurrection shrine will still activate when approached if any party member has more unspent Kurzick faction than Luxon faction, even if the priest is unfriendly to the party.
{{anomaly |Similar to [[Luxon Priest]]s, if the Kurzick Priest is unfriendly to your party when first approached:
* The Kurzick Priest and his accompanying shrine NPCs (i.e. [[Kurzick Merchant]] and [[Kurzick Guard|Guards]]) will not attack the [[foe]]s of your party and those foes will not attack the shrine NPCs.
* The Kurzick Priest will [[heal]] allies (e.g. your party members) and foes. He will prioritize healing an ally over a foe when both an ally and foe require healing.
* All of this occurs whether or not you bribe that Kurzick Priest.}}
